title: PSRs in Action - Real-World PHP Standards From PHP-FIG
author: Stefan Bogdanescu
excerpt: Explore how PHP-FIG's PSRs apply in real-world PHP development. Learn PSR-4 autoloading, PSR-11 containers, PSR-3 logging, and PSR-7 HTTP messaging with practical code examples.
